1.consolidated_definition: Desnudarse, especialmente con intenciones exhibicionistas o deshonestas. Libre trío que “peló pa’bajo” en plaza del Viejo San Juan. (Primer Hora, 08-05-14)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To strip oneself bare, especially with exhibitionistic or dishonest intentions. A free trio that "exposed themselves" in Old San Juan Plaza.
